ordering_principle: prespecified reasoning sequence, not numerical performance rank

models.role: Baseline model. Establish Gaussian BLR calibration before adding nonlinear age or thickness.
models.conclusion: Retained as the prespecified no-thickness sensitivity model.

models.role: First age-form test: compare M1 with M0 before considering thickness.
models.conclusion: Not selected: spline age did not improve held-out NLPD or calibration consistently.

models.formula: MD ~ linear age + categorical sex_code + local FreeSurfer cortical thickness
models.role: Thickness test under the selected linear age form: compare M2 with M0.
models.conclusion: Selected uniform mean model for the future ico4 analysis, subject to the Gaussian-tail QC gate.

models.formula: MD ~ natural_cubic_spline(age, df=3) + categorical sex_code + local FreeSurfer cortical thickness
models.role: Cross-check the age-form decision after thickness adjustment: compare M3 with M2.
models.conclusion: Not selected: spline age added no stable OOF benefit over M2.
